diagnostics: Deterministic CPU BVH; 3 diffuse bounces. SH stores cosine-convolved irradiance E; Lambert use E/PI.

Actual geometry occludes every light/environment ray. Visibility/depth moments are camera independent. Straight thin-sheet transmission includes Fresnel and Beer attenuation; solid refraction and caustics are not solved.

Irradiance includes visibility-filtered environment and bounced surface radiance, but no directly sampled delta lights at probes. Keep analytic direct lighting separate. Local reflection images are linear radiance, without exposure/tone mapping.
